title: Gate operations in the layered circuit
statement: For every Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables, every gate operation in its associated layered feedforward circuit is either the identity operation, the unary operation $x \mapsto 1-x_0$, or an AND operation of some finite arity, given by $x \mapsto \prod_i x_i$ on inputs in $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit c on n variables
